selection_rule: Zero-based floor(N/4), floor(N/2), floor(3N/4) source windows per episode. Explicit named or uniquely contextual games and game products; preserve no-title windows. Hardware, generic character-branded hardware mentions, books, films and unnamed aggregate consoles are excluded. Source-adjacent context consulted for Faxanadu and Diablo record only, before extraction.
limits: Six bounded game/product references, not statistical recall. All three CQ82 selected windows concern hardware/event organization; Pikachu one is ambiguous hardware/software and excluded with this explicit note, not silently normalized.
